final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Symptom side: alert on business action 'Process payment' via ts-inside-payment-service returns HTTPError('500 Server Error'); its error log shows java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Service Instance cannot be null (load balancer has no available instance for the downstream payment call); TCP probe to ts-payment-service:19001 (the port its Service declares) failed from worker-01/02/03. Object layer: only outlier pod is ts-payment-service-6cbd66f447-ks5sb, 1/2 Running, RESTARTS 4, Ready False; its app container terminated with Reason: Error, Exit Code: 1 (not 137/OOM), restart count 4, and pod event 'Warning BackOff - Back-off restarting failed container ts-payment-service in pod ts-payment-service-6cbd66f447-ks5sb_train-ticket'. Mechanism: container log shows 'PortInUseException: Port 19001 is already in use' and 'APPLICATION FAILED TO START ... Web server failed to start. Port 19001 was already in use.', while the istio-proxy sidecar log shows 'Opening status port 19001'. Config closure: GetAppYAML(ts-payment-service) shows pod template annotation proxy.istio.io/config: { "statusPort": 19001 } (sidecar status port) colliding with the app container containerPort 19001 and Service port 19001 / readinessProbe tcpSocket 19001. Chain: sidecar status port equals the app listen port -> app exits 1 -> CrashLoopBackOff -> readiness never passes -> Service has zero ready endpoints -> upstream payment call gets 500 -> availability disruption.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-payment-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-payment-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        proxy.istio.io/config: '{ "statusPort": 19001 }'
      labels:
        app: ts-payment-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-payment-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-payment-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-payment-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 19001
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 19001
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-payment-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 19001
  selector:
    app: ts-payment-service
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-payment-mysql
type: Opaque
stringData:
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_HOST: tsdb-mysql-leader
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_PORT: '3306'
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_USER: ts
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_PASSWORD: Ts_123456
